title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm camcorder POV. CHASE films herself throughout. Natural shake, imperfect framing, slow focus, clumsy zooms, tape aesthetic. Camera never visible.
LOOK:
Soft VHS/DV quality with slight blur, tape noise, bloomed highlights, auto-exposure flicker, realistic skin tones. Lighting changes by location.
STYLE:
Nostalgic trainee flashback montage with reflective voiceover. Raw, emotional, determined. Quick cuts showing growth from exhaustion to quiet confidence.
CHARACTER:
CHASE (Image), Korean trainee, late teens/early 20s. Long black hair in a ponytail/braid, minimal makeup, simple long-sleeve practice clothes and joggers.
LOCATIONS:
Dorm → Vocal room → Dance studio → Hallway → Evaluation room.
STORYBOARD (20s, 8 cuts):
Wakes before sunrise in the dorm. VO: "Back then, mornings started before the sun."
Vocal warmups at the mic. VO: "Every note mattered."
Misses a note, exhales, tries again. Ambient only.
Repeats choreography in the studio. VO: "I practiced that same move a hundred times."
Close-up of tired feet dancing. Ambient only.
Resting in the hallway with a small smile. VO: "Sometimes, something finally clicked."
Waiting before evaluators. VO: "Then it was time to prove it."
Close-up before performing. VO: "That version of me started everything."

es.content:
CAMERA:
POV de una videocámara DV 16mm handheld. CHASE se filma a sí misma durante todo el tiempo. Temblor natural, encuadre imperfecto, enfoque lento, zooms torpes, estética de cinta. La cámara nunca es visible.
LOOK:
Calidad suave tipo VHS/DV con ligero desenfoque, ruido de cinta, altas luces reventadas, parpadeo de autoexposición, tonos de piel realistas. La iluminación cambia según la ubicación.
STYLE:
Montaje nostálgico de recuerdos de trainee con voiceover reflexivo. Crudo, emotivo, decidido. Cortes rápidos que muestran la evolución del agotamiento a una confianza tranquila.
CHARACTER:
CHASE (Image), trainee coreana, finales de la adolescencia/principios de los 20. Cabello largo negro en coleta/trenza, maquillaje mínimo, ropa sencilla de práctica de manga larga y joggers.
LOCATIONS:
Dormitorio → Sala vocal → Estudio de danza → Pasillo → Sala de evaluación.
STORYBOARD (20s, 8 cuts):
Se despierta antes del amanecer en el dormitorio. VO: "Back then, mornings started before the sun."
Calentamientos vocales frente al micrófono. VO: "Every note mattered."
Falla una nota, exhala, lo intenta de nuevo. Solo ambiente.
Repite la coreografía en el estudio. VO: "I practiced that same move a hundred times."
Primer plano de pies cansados bailando. Solo ambiente.
Descansando en el pasillo con una pequeña sonrisa. VO: "Sometimes, something finally clicked."
Esperando antes de los evaluadores. VO: "Then it was time to prove it."
Primer plano antes de actuar. VO: "That version of me started everything."

fr.content:
CAMÉRA :
POV d’un caméscope DV 16 mm tenu à la main. CHASE se filme tout au long de la séquence. Tremblements naturels, cadrage imparfait, mise au point lente, zooms maladroits, esthétique de cassette. La caméra n’est jamais visible.

LOOK :
Qualité VHS/DV douce avec léger flou, bruit de bande, hautes lumières qui bavent, scintillement de l’auto-exposition, tons de peau réalistes. L’éclairage change selon les lieux.

STYLE :
Montage nostalgique de flashback d’une trainee avec voix off introspective. Brut, émotionnel, déterminé. Coupes rapides montrant l’évolution de l’épuisement vers une confiance tranquille.

CHARACTER :
CHASE (Image), trainee coréenne, fin d’adolescence/début de vingtaine. Longs cheveux noirs en queue de cheval/tresse, maquillage minimal, tenue simple de répétition à manches longues et jogging.

LOCATIONS :
Dorm → Vocal room → Dance studio → Hallway → Evaluation room.

STORYBOARD (20s, 8 cuts) :
Se réveille avant le lever du soleil dans le dortoir. VO : "Back then, mornings started before the sun."
Échauffements vocaux au micro. VO : "Every note mattered."
Rate une note, expire, réessaie. Ambiance seule.
Répète la chorégraphie dans le studio. VO : "I practiced that same move a hundred times."
Gros plan sur des pieds fatigués qui dansent. Ambiance seule.
Se repose dans le couloir avec un léger sourire. VO : "Sometimes, something finally clicked."
Attend avant l’évaluation. VO : "Then it was time to prove it."
Gros plan avant de performer. VO : "That version of me started everything."

ja.content:
CAMERA:
ハンドヘルドDV 16mmカムコーダーのPOV。CHASEが全編を自分で撮影している。自然な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、ゆっくりしたフォーカス、ぎこちないズーム、テープ風の質感。カメラは決して映らない。
LOOK:
わずかなぼけ、テープノイズ、白飛びしたハイライト、オート露出のちらつき、リアルな肌の色味を伴う、ソフトなVHS/DVクオリティ。ライティングはロケーションごとに変化する。
STYLE:
内省的なナレーションを伴う、ノスタルジックな練習生の回想モンタージュ。生々しく、感情的で、決意に満ちている。疲労から静かな自信へと変化していく様子を、クイックカットで描く。
CHARACTER:
CHASE（Image）、韓国人の練習生、10代後半〜20代前半。長い黒髪をポニーテール／三つ編みにまとめ、メイクは最小限、シンプルな長袖の練習着とジョガーパンツ。
LOCATIONS:
寮 → ボーカルルーム → ダンススタジオ → 廊下 → 評価室。
STORYBOARD（20秒、8カット）:
夜明け前に寮で目を覚ます。VO: "Back then, mornings started before the sun."
マイクの前でボーカルのウォームアップ。VO: "Every note mattered."
音を外し、息を吐いて、もう一度挑戦する。環境音のみ。
スタジオで振り付けを繰り返す。VO: "I practiced that same move a hundred times."
疲れた足元のクローズアップで踊る。環境音のみ。
廊下で少し微笑みながら休む。VO: "Sometimes, something finally clicked."
審査員の前で待つ。VO: "Then it was time to prove it."
パフォーマンス直前のクローズアップ。VO: "That version of me started everything."

ko.content:
CAMERA:
핸드헬드 DV 16mm 캠코더 POV. CHASE가 전 과정을 직접 촬영한다. 자연스러운 흔들림, 완벽하지 않은 구도, 느린 초점, 서툰 줌, 테이프 질감. 카메라는 절대 보이지 않음.
LOOK:
약간의 블러, 테이프 노이즈, 번진 하이라이트, 자동 노출 깜빡임, 사실적인 피부 톤이 있는 부드러운 VHS/DV 화질. 조명은 장소에 따라 달라짐.
STYLE:
회상적인 내레이션이 들어간 향수 어린 연습생 플래시백 몽타주. 날것의, 감정적인, 결연한 분위기. 지침에서 지친 모습에서 조용한 자신감으로 성장하는 과정을 보여주는 빠른 컷.
CHARACTER:
CHASE (Image), 한국인 연습생, 10대 후반/20대 초반. 긴 검은 머리를 포니테일/브레이드로 묶고, 옅은 메이크업, 심플한 긴팔 연습복과 조거 팬츠 착용.
LOCATIONS:
기숙사 → 보컬룸 → 댄스 스튜디오 → 복도 → 평가실.
STORYBOARD (20s, 8 cuts):
기숙사에서 해 뜨기 전에 일어난다. VO: "그땐, 해가 뜨기 전부터 아침이 시작됐어요."
마이크 앞에서 보컬 워밍업을 한다. VO: "모든 음이 중요했죠."
한 음을 놓치고, 숨을 내쉰 뒤 다시 시도한다. Ambient only.
스튜디오에서 안무를 반복한다. VO: "같은 동작을 백 번은 연습했어요."
지친 발이 춤추는 클로즈업. Ambient only.
복도에서 잠시 쉬며 작은 미소를 짓는다. VO: "가끔은, 마침내 무언가가 딱 맞아떨어졌어요."
평가를 기다린다. VO: "그리고 이제 증명할 시간이었죠."
공연 직전의 클로즈업. VO: "그때의 내가 모든 걸 시작했어요."

pt.content:
CAMERA:
POV de camcorder DV 16mm handheld. CHASE se filma ao longo de toda a cena. Tremor natural, enquadramento imperfeito, foco lento, zooms desajeitados, estética de fita. A câmera nunca fica visível.
LOOK:
Qualidade suave de VHS/DV com leve desfoque, ruído de fita, highlights estourados, flicker de autoexposição, tons de pele realistas. A iluminação muda conforme a locação.
STYLE:
Montagem nostálgica de flashback de trainee com voiceover reflexivo. Cru, emocional, determinado. Cortes rápidos mostrando a evolução do esgotamento para uma confiança tranquila.
CHARACTER:
CHASE (Image), trainee coreana, fim da adolescência/início dos 20 anos. Cabelo longo preto em rabo de cavalo/trança, maquiagem mínima, roupas simples de prática de manga longa e joggers.
LOCATIONS:
Dormitório → Sala de vocal → Estúdio de dança → Corredor → Sala de avaliação.
STORYBOARD (20s, 8 cuts):
Acorda antes do nascer do sol no dormitório. VO: "Back then, mornings started before the sun."
Aquecimentos vocais no microfone. VO: "Every note mattered."
Erra uma nota, solta o ar, tenta de novo. Som ambiente apenas.
Repete a coreografia no estúdio. VO: "I practiced that same move a hundred times."
Close-up dos pés cansados dançando. Som ambiente apenas.
Descansando no corredor com um pequeno sorriso. VO: "Sometimes, something finally clicked."
Esperando antes dos avaliadores. VO: "Then it was time to prove it."
Close-up antes da apresentação. VO: "That version of me started everything."

zh.content:
CAMERA:
手持 DV 16mm 摄像机 POV。CHASE 全程自己拍摄。自然抖动、构图不完美、慢速对焦、笨拙变焦、磁带质感。镜头始终不可见。
LOOK:
柔和的 VHS/DV 画质，带轻微模糊、磁带噪点、过曝高光、自动曝光闪烁、真实肤色。光线随地点变化。
STYLE:
带有反思性旁白的怀旧练习生回忆蒙太奇。粗粝、情绪化、坚定。快速剪辑展现从疲惫到安静自信的成长。
CHARACTER:
CHASE（Image），韩国练习生，十几岁末/二十出头。黑色长发扎成马尾/辫子，淡妆，简单的长袖练习服和运动裤。
LOCATIONS:
宿舍 → 声乐室 → 舞蹈室 → 走廊 → 评审室。
STORYBOARD（20秒，8个镜头）：
天未亮时在宿舍醒来。VO: "那时候，早晨总是在太阳升起之前开始。"
在麦克风前做声乐热身。VO: "每一个音都很重要。"
唱错一个音，呼气，再试一次。仅环境音。
在舞蹈室里反复练习编舞。VO: "同一个动作，我练了上百遍。"
疲惫的脚在跳舞的特写。仅环境音。
在走廊里休息，露出一丝微笑。VO: "有时候，某件事终于一下子明白了。"
在评审前等待。VO: "然后，是时候证明自己了。"
表演前的特写。VO: "正是那个版本的我，开启了一切。"
